final_text:
Submitted as run_id ADD-03-host-20261005T184400Z-be27 with status "partial". I read no crops, because none of these provisions rely on an image.

- **Coverage:** all 7 provisions in this batch are covered. The 50 the tool lists as unaccounted belong to other batches.
- **Checked and verified (3):** ADD-03/3.1, 3.2 and 4.1. In 4.1 I used the micro sign "µm" as the addendum prints it; the draft reference had the Greek letter mu instead.
- **Waiting for a person to confirm (4):**
  - ADD-03/3.3 covers both 3.3 and 3.3(b). It replaces the whole of the current Volume V Clause 29.2 with the new text, so someone needs to confirm the old text it removes.
  - ADD-03/3.4 and 4.2 change no text. I recorded them as "adds obligation" notes on Volume I Clause 10.3 and Volume II Section 3.
  - ADD-03/3.3-form is a clarification question: Form 4-F has no field for the indexed percentage that the new Clause 29.2 tells bidders to state there.
- **Open flag:** the engine notes that no register row yet holds the new "Base Date" definition (Clause 1.1A).
